messages:
zoe: Hey everyone — Zoe here, first day as Product Designer! Quick access Qs: Figma org invite hasn't arrived, Notion /Product returns 403, and I can't find the roadmap doc or research consent template. Also, who is my onboarding buddy for design?

jules: welcome @zoe :wave: I'm design-ops. I sent the Figma SSO invite at 09:12 — check spam/Other tab. If you see "Request access" DM me your exact work email. Roadmap lives in Notion > Product > Roadmap; I'll add you when the SSO group sync completes. We assign a 2-week buddy for new designers, will pair you now.

kiran: hi @zoe, research-ops here. Consent template + screener are in Drive > UX > Templates (consent_standard_v3.docx, screener_template.md). Recruitment vendor is InsightPartners (recruit@insightpartners.com). Participant payments: use FlexPay for <$150, procurement handles vendor invoices for larger panels. Loop Legal for external messaging.

zoe: Thanks — Figma link shows: `You need permission to view this file` when I click it.

it-bot: :key: IT ticket created: IT-8133 for Notion group sync and Figma SSO reissue for zoe@redwood.com.

jules: Manual add triggered for the "Product Designers" team in Figma — you should receive an invite now. If you still hit an error paste the exact text here. Dropped a starter kit: https://drive.google.com/uc?id=REDACTED (tokens, components, starter frames).

emily: welcome @zoe! I'm your onboarding buddy this week — can do a 30-min product context sync at 2pm. Short roadmap TL;DR in thread: Q2 priorities = latency improvements, routing policy rollout, and onboarding UX work.

zoe: Got the Figma invite, I can open the DS file 🎉 Notion still 403 though. 2pm sync works for me. Would love to shadow a moderated research session this week to learn our note-taking conventions.

kiran: Added you to #user-research and gave you observer access for Thurs 11:00 moderated session. Note title convention: `YYYYMMDD_feature_persona_sessionID`. We also tag persona, prototype, and moderated/unmoderated in the note metadata.

jules: IT says Notion group sync ETA ~4 hours; I'll upload a PDF copy of the roadmap + PRD template to Drive and share it to you in DMs so you can start. Buddy assigned to @emily for 2 weeks.

emily: See you at 2pm! If Notion is still blocked after EOD I'll escalate to IT directly. Post any other access errors here and we'll sort them.

zoe: Thank you all — really appreciate the quick help. I'll update this thread if Notion still blocks after EOD or if anything else pops up.
